newsitem.title: UK: Barclays leads banks up after BoS results.
newsitem.headline: Barclays leads banks up after BoS results.

text.p: Barclays Plc and other leading bank shares led the UK market higher in early trade on Thursday in further reaction to Bank of Scotland Plc's results on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The whole sector is good on the back of the Bank of Scotland figures," said one.
Barclays was up 18p at 10.76-1/2 stg by 0832 GMT in volume of 1.4 million shares, Lloyds TSB Plc was up 6-1/2p at 543-1/2 and National Westminster Bank Plc was up 8p at 709.
Abbey National Plc, due to issue a trading statement later today to coincide with its annual general meeting, was up 10p at 825.
HSBC Holdings Plc was up 20p at 15.76 stg, also boosted by a firm performance by shares in Hong Kong earlier today.
